summary: HedgeDoc is a collaborative Markdown note-taking server (NestJS + Knex over PostgreSQL): users create notes addressed by aliases, edit them via revisions (with realtime Yjs persistence), share them via per-user/per-group permissions and public visibility, upload media linked to notes, authenticate via local/LDAP/OIDC/guest, and list/explore notes (own, shared, public, pinned, recently-visited).

_no_edges.why: read-only info endpoint (no mutating op); only SessionGuard auth on the controller, calls nothing (groups.controller.ts:27)
internal leaf read helper; calls nothing (revisions.service.ts:250)
internal fire-and-forget visit marker (row_upsert); its caller edge is captured on Note.get (note.service.ts:368)
internal read of a media row + backend; no guard of its own, access delegated to caller MediaUpload.redirect.getMedia (media.service.ts:169)
internal helper that inserts a guest User row; no preconditions beyond the GuestsEnabledGuard on its only caller Auth.registerGuest, calls nothing downstream (users.service.ts:101)
OIDC login initiation that only writes the current Session and redirects to the provider; no DB precondition, calls no other op (oidc.controller.ts:62)
